question: Why does the devotee offer exclusive reverence to the goddess as siddhi-vidyā?
premises: The devotee bows to the goddess alone
She is addressed as goddess of the worlds
She is identified as the knowledge of success
inference: The devotee reveres the goddess exclusively as the supreme knowledge that grants accomplishment in all worlds.
plain_english: O goddess, I bow to you alone, the knowledge of success for all the worlds.
